gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-supreme: Funnel Display draws every stroke like spaghetti, loud and uniform, with no swelling anywhere. Supreme takes over below with a dense, crisp sans that holds its letters open and keeps the text looking sturdy.
gen-gf-grandstander-satoshi: Satoshi sets the tone with a soaring x-height.  Its wide e stays open, and Grandstander's plain, constant lines shout above it, so the whole pairing feels friendly and loud.
gen-gf-offside-manrope: Manrope reads bright and approachable, with gaps at the mouth of every curve and a pen line that never changes width. And Offside, widely tracked and a bit stubborn about closing its curves, gives it a bold, commanding partner.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk leaves its bowls unfinished on one side, which gives the text a lively, slightly restless feel beneath Gugi's unswelling strokes. Their shared tall lowercase is the strongest link.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-hind: Loud, low-slung and cheerful, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height. And Hind follows with lowercase nearly matching its capitals and strokes steady as a drawn string, so paragraphs stay level.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-nunito: Metamorphous arrives with generous sidebearings and a high-set midline. Nunito's round, friendly lowercase bowls take the sentences from there, so the sturdy heading hands off to soft, approachable text without a jolt.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Paprika scatters its letters wide, with lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Pilcrow Rounded tucks its spacing tight and keeps big counters in a tall lowercase, so paragraphs feel warm and steady rather than showy.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk reads lively and a touch unfinished, since each bowl stays open on one side. And Revalia, with its relaxed stride across widely separated letters, supplies the bold contrast that makes the two worth putting together.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-alpino: Snowburst One looks like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges cut between letters. Alpino is the cozy, casual one, its tall body making the ascenders look short, so the stencil handles the shouting and the text handles the talking.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-nunito: Tektur cuts its strokes like ribbon of constant width, with generous openings on every curve. Nunito does the gentler job, rounding its lowercase bowls and leaving terminals clear of the stem, so the heading stays showy while the text stays friendly.
